JoelHjert.MoonVillage.StopTheGathering.Title: Stop the Gathering
JoelHjert.MoonVillage.StopTheGathering.Description: Annette has seen signs of monsters gathering near the hidden maze. Find the maze and stop them before Moonvillage is threatened again.
JoelHjert.MoonVillage.StopTheGathering.AcceptText: Annette's warning has been added to your Moonvillage requests.
JoelHjert.MoonVillage.StopTheGathering.CompleteText: The gathering has been stopped. Moonvillage breathes easier tonight.
JoelHjert.MoonVillage.StopTheGathering.ObjectiveText: Enter the hidden maze and defeat 10 Green Slimes.

JoelHjert.MoonVillage.ForestSupplies.Title: Forest Supplies
JoelHjert.MoonVillage.ForestSupplies.Description: Moonvillage needs sturdy wood for repairs around the old paths.
JoelHjert.MoonVillage.ForestSupplies.CompleteText: The repair supplies have been delivered.
JoelHjert.MoonVillage.ForestSupplies.ObjectiveText: Bring 50 wood to the Moon Village Requests board.
